text: I'm 48 and so is this hotel. We both still have a lot life in us, but we have some gray hair too. The Westin is a nice hotel, with large guest rooms and very convenient if you want access to the Galleria Mall or tne many restaurants in the area. The hotel staff is friendly and efficient (mostly). The area is great. Lots and lots of restaurants and shopping. But if you are looking for the newest flat screen TV or a suite style arrangement for the rooms, look elsewhere. In short the hotel is due for a remodel, but it's far from terrible or shoddy. For the price, we booked at Priceline, this is a solid hotel choice. Very comfortable.
